mapping_records.mapping_rationale: A repository boundary can separate one history/object namespace from another while still allowing exchange through explicit transfer operations.
mapping_records.preserved_meaning: A bounded locus is distinguishable from other loci and can mediate exchanges.
mapping_records.changed_meaning: Git boundaries are tool-defined repository/object/reference scopes, not necessarily conceptual, organizational, or architectural boundaries.
alternatives: Treat branch boundaries rather than repository boundaries as the primary boundary
Treat remotes as relationship edges instead of boundaries

mapping_records.mapping_rationale: Parent links and refs preserve navigable historical continuity across commits while allowing reference movement.
mapping_records.preserved_meaning: A lineage or continuity relation can be followed through recorded state transitions.
mapping_records.changed_meaning: Git continuity is explicit graph ancestry and ref movement, not a generalized continuity principle.
alternatives: Map continuity only to commit ancestry
Map continuity to branch naming conventions

mapping_records.mapping_rationale: Distributed workflows move and integrate changes between repositories or branches using explicit operations.
mapping_records.preserved_meaning: A recognizable movement of structured state occurs across a domain boundary or relation.
mapping_records.changed_meaning: Git transfer has concrete transport and merge mechanics that may not match Structology transfer semantics.
alternatives: Map transfer only to fetch/push and not merge
Map merge to reconciliation rather than transfer

mapping_records.mapping_rationale: Commits and merges can be rehearsed as state-bearing events because commits record snapshots and merges integrate divergent histories.
mapping_records.preserved_meaning: A domain condition can be identified before or after a recorded change.
mapping_records.changed_meaning: Git state is snapshot/history specific and does not necessarily express broader Structology state semantics.
alternatives: Map state only to commit snapshots
Map state to working tree/index/HEAD rather than committed history
